source.title: NIST Special Publication 800-77 Revision 1: Guide to IPsec VPNs
source.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
source.applicability: Provides authoritative technical guidance on IPsec protocol implementation including configuration of security associations, key management, and network traffic selectors. Directly addresses VPN implementation, traffic controls, and secure remote connectivity boundaries in the scope.
